name: Solvarch

abilityDetails.Fractured Power Bar: Şampiyon, elindeki güç barına göre farklı özel saldırı türlerini belirli olasılıklarla kullanır.
abilityDetails.Parry Non-Contact: Siper (Parry) ustalığının temassız saldırılara karşı da Stun tetiklemesini sağlar.
abilityDetails.Armor Up: Zırh değerini artırarak alınan fiziksel hasarı azaltır.
abilityDetails.Coldsnap: Ani soğuk hasarı verir ve düşmanın Kaçış yeteneğini kapatır.
abilityDetails.Reverb: Bu şampiyonun vuruşları, verilen hasara dayalı ek fiziksel hasar patlaması verir.
abilityDetails.Energize: Muharebe Güç Oranını belirtilen güçte artırır.
abilityDetails.Steadfast: Aktifken, Unblockable saldırılar sanki değillermiş gibi bloklanabilir.

howToPlay: Bu şampiyona karşı (savunmada): Devasa kritik direnci ve enerji hasarı yansıtması var, iyileşme tersine çevirmeye immün. Enerji olmayan doğrudan hasar tercih et. Pasif zırhı aktifken kritik gücünü %80 azaltır — zırh kıran şampiyon şart, zırhsız kalırsa savunma potansiyeli çöker. Enerji hasarının %50'sini iyileştirir ve (Cosmic değilsen) %50'sini yansıtır — rupture/degeneration/disintegration/güçlü iğne efektleri de iyi.
signatureAbility:
The Wolf of the Stars
When Solvarch's Block would be Broken due to Unblockable or Crush effects, consume [5 - 2] Armor Up Passives (rounded up) to gain a Steadfast Passive for 2 seconds. If the hit is from a Special Attack, reduce the Armor Up cost by 50% (rounded down).
While Solvarch has a Steadfast, they are Immune to Crush.
immunityDetails:
• Kanama Bağışıklığı 🩸
• Zehir Bağışıklığı 🧪
• İyileşme Tersine Çevirmeye dirençli 💚🔄❌

abilitySections.title: Technical Eidol Physiology - Always Active
content: Solvarch is a Tech Eidol and thus has a Fractured Power Bar and is Immune to Bleed and Poison effects.
Solvarch's Regeneration Rate cannot be reduced below 50%. Against Mutants it cannot be reduced below 100%.
Solvarch's Parry Mastery can trigger its Stun against Non-Contact Attacks.
Solvarch cannot land Critical Hits, but gains +[1,415.25] Attack Rating for each active Energize effect.

abilitySections.title: Armor Ups
content: Start each fight with 5 indefinite Armor Up Passives, each granting +[687.5] Armor Rating. These Armor Up Passives can be removed by Armor Breaks.
While Solvarch has any active Armor Up effects, they also reduce the Opponent's Critical Penetration by -80% flat.

abilitySections.title: ISO Core - Max Charge: 100
content: The ISO Core inside Solvarch's chest can be in either Absorb Mode or Release Mode, starting each fight in Absorb Mode with 25 Core Charge.
Against non-Cosmic Opponents, when Charged to 100, Solvarch inflicts a non-stacking 50% Kinetic Discharge Passive for 10 seconds, on non-Cosmic Opponents paused while at 100 Core Charge.
When Solvarch takes Energy Damage, they Passively Regenerate 50% of the damage taken and build 10 Core Charge.
When Solvarch takes damage from a Mutant, they build 10 Core Charge.
When the Opponent is inflicted with a Coldsnap Debuff, Solvarch builds 5 Core Charge.
When Solvarch activates a Special Attack, they build 10 Core Charge for each full Bar of Power remaining.

abilitySections.title: ISO Core Absorb Mode
content: Build 1 Core Charge every second.
Solvarch's second Medium Attack inflicts a Coldsnap Debuff dealing [2,830.5] Energy Damage over 20 seconds.

abilitySections.title: ISO Core Release Mode
content: Lose 4 Core Charge every second.
Gain a Reverb Passive with up to 300% potency based on the current Core Charge.

abilitySections.title: Special Attacks - Divert Charge
content: Tapping Block during Solvarch's Special Attacks grants bonuses for each tap.
Absorb Mode: Consume 10 Core Charge to gain an indefinite +[687.5]% Armor Up Passive. Max stacks: 10. These Armor Up Passives can be removed by Armor Breaks.
Release Mode: Consume 1 Armor Up effect to gain an +15% Energize Passive for 14 seconds, paused during Special Attacks. Max stacks: 10.
Solvarch gains an additional +50% Combat Power Rate while at max Energize stacks.
As a Defender, Solvarch converts all available Core Charge or half of available Armor Ups over the course of their Special Attack.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1 - ISO Polarity Shift
content: On activation, change the ISO Core Mode.
Absorb Mode: If Solvarch has at least 5 Armor Up Passives, the final hit Power Drains 30% of the Opponent's current Power.
Release Mode: If Solvarch has at least 5 Energize Passives, the final hit inflicts a Stun Debuff for 2.5 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2 - Hyper Kinetic Flurry
content: Absorb Mode: The final hit inflicts a Power Drain Debuff, draining 2% of the Opponent's current Power per second, for 10 seconds, paused while in Absorb Mode.
Release Mode: The final hit inflicts a Heal Block Passive for 15 seconds, paused while in Release Mode.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3 - ISO Core Unbound
content: Increase Attack Rating by up to +[42,457.5] based on Core Charge.
At the end of this attack consume all of Solvarch's Core Charge, and enter Absorb Mode.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - The Wolf of the Stars
content: When Solvarch's Block would be Broken due to Unblockable or Crush effects, consume [5 - 2] Armor Up Passives (rounded up) to gain a Steadfast Passive for 2 seconds. If the hit is from a Special Attack, reduce the Armor Up cost by 50% (rounded down).
While Solvarch has a Steadfast, they are Immune to Crush.
